description: Phase 5 mirror-plane barcode boundaries mapped to exact angular crossings, tolerance ranges, and continuity-checked candidate intervals.

coordinate_notes.mirror_measurements: Distances from the hinge-side glass edge on the rectified mirror plane.
coordinate_notes.exact_crossings: Linearly interpolated angles where the model prediction equals the measured mirror distance.
coordinate_notes.tolerance_ranges: Angles whose valid model predictions are within the configured tolerance; these are uncertainty bands, not exact solutions.
coordinate_notes.paired_interval: Selected only if exactly one pair of exact crossings passes visibility, glass-boundary, measured-range, and monotonicity checks.
coordinate_notes.vertical_coordinates: Original Phase 5 vertical measurements are preserved but are not converted to tube axial coordinates by this top-down 2D model.
coordinate_notes.orientation: Barcode orientation is preserved as supplied by Phase 5. No crop rotation or coordinate transposition is performed.
coordinate_notes.validation: All angular results remain model estimates and require physical validation against measured tube/barcode positions.

paired_angular_interval.note: A selected interval is a model-derived candidate, not a physically validated result.
